script_text: Sagittarius, a lunar eclipse detonates across your chart this week — brace your foundations. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury in your 9th House sextiles Mars in your 7th, sharpening every pitch, negotiation, and bold ask. Your ruler Jupiter blazes through fire sign Leo in your 9th House, sextile Uranus — unexpected money flows through partnerships. Thursday, the Virgo Sun trines Uranus in your 10th House — career doors fly open. But Friday's Partial Lunar Eclipse in Pisces strikes your 4th House of home, squaring Uranus in your 7th — family or partner bombshells land. In love, Mars ignites your 7th House — a relationship plot twist is fate. Sunday, Venus in your 11th House heals — warm reconciliations win. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury sextile Mars supercharges every conversation. Friday is your hardest day — avoid ultimatums under eclipse fog. Delay every big decision seventy-two hours. Follow for daily updates.
